name: Kingston Flemings

name: Jock Landale
comment: Landale (hip) won't play Sunday against the Pistons.

name: Asa Newell

name: CJ McCollum
comment: McCollum (calf) will miss at least four weeks, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.

name: Mouhamed Gueye

name: Henri Veesaar
comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

name: Mitchell Robinson
comment: Robinson (illness) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Kings, Keith Smith of Spotrac.com reports.

name: Derrick White
comment: White (shoulder) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against Sacramento.

name: Jayson Tatum
comment: Tatum (rest) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Kings.

name: Nolan Traore
comment: Traore (hamstring) won't return to Friday's game against Orlando, Meghan Triplett of YES Network reports. He finished with four points (2-6 FG, 0-2 3Pt) and two assists over 18 minutes.

name: Grant Nelson
comment: Nelson (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Orlando.

name: Grant Williams
comment: Williams (hamstring) is listed as out for Friday's game versus the Hawks.

name: Grayson Allen
comment: Allen (concussion) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Atlanta.

name: Kon Knueppel

name: Dennis Schroder
comment: Schroder has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

name: Norman Powell
comment: Powell is questionable for Sunday's game against the Nuggets due to a right hamstring strain.

name: Jalen Smith

name: Tobe Awaka

name: Jaylon Tyson
comment: Tyson (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Indiana.

name: Nae'Qwan Tomlin
comment: Tomlin (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.

name: Evan Mobley
comment: Mobley will receive treatment and participate in rehab after the team confirmed a diagnosis of a right great toe sprain, and he'll be re-evaluated in the next 7-to-10 days.

name: P.J. Washington
comment: Washington (illness/shoulder) is listed as out for Saturday's game against the Clippers.

name: Tobi Lawal
comment: Lawal (groin) is out for Saturday's game against the Clippers.

name: Sergio de Larrea
comment: De Larrea (knee) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.

name: Tarik Biberovic
comment: Biberovic (heel) is out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.

name: Julian Strawther
comment: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

name: Ronald Holland II
comment: Holland (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Atlanta.

name: Ebuka Okorie
comment: Okorie (oblique) is out for Sunday's game in Atlanta.

name: Cade Cunningham
comment: Cunningham (knee) is probable to play Sunday in Atlanta.

name: Taurean Prince
comment: Prince (knee) underwent surgery to address lingering issues and has no timeline for a return, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

name: Ugonna Onyenso
comment: Onyenso agreed to a two-way contract with the Pistons on Thursday.

name: Duncan Robinson
comment: Robinson will be re-evaluated in one week due to a left quadriceps strain, Coty M. Davis of The Detroit News reports.

name: Jalen Duren
comment: Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

name: Draymond Green
comment: Green (elbow) is out for Thursday's game against the Grizzlies.

name: Brandon Williams
comment: Williams (hamstring) has progressed to on-court activities and will be re-evaluated Saturday.

name: Stephen Curry
comment: Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Kristaps Porzingis
comment: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

name: Moses Moody
comment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

name: Jimmy Butler III
comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

name: Clint Capela
comment: Capela (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Denver.

name: T.J. McConnell
comment: McConnell (hamstring) is listed as out for Sunday's game in New York.

name: Pascal Siakam
comment: Siakam (hip) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against New York.

name: Tyrese Haliburton
comment: Haliburton (hamstring) is expected to miss at least two more weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Johnny Furphy
comment: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

name: Ben Sheppard
comment: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

name: Brandon Ingram
comment: Ingram (Achilles) is expected to make his season and team debut Monday against the Rockets, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Bradley Beal
comment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

name: Jordan Miller
comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

name: Austin Reaves
comment: Head coach JJ Redick said he expects Reaves (heel) to return for Monday's matchup with Utah or Friday's game in San Antonio, Mark Medina of TheSportingTribune.com reports.

name: Jerami Grant
comment: Grant (calf) is out for Saturday's game against the Timberwolves.

name: Javon Small
comment: Small won't play Saturday against the Timberwolves due to personal reasons.

name: Cameron Boozer
comment: Boozer is out for Saturday's game against Minnesota due to a right ankle sprain.

name: GG Jackson
comment: Jackson underwent a procedure Wednesday to repair a broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot. He is expected to recover fully and will be re-evaluated in approximately three months.

name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
comment: Pippen (back) is progressing in his recovery but is still considered week-to-week.

name: Richie Saunders
comment: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Myron Gardner
comment: Gardner (hamstring) is probable for Sunday's game against the Thunder.

name: Giannis Antetokounmpo
comment: Antetokounmpo (groin) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Oklahoma City, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

name: Ousmane Dieng

name: Jaylen Clark
comment: Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the next two weeks.

name: Anthony Edwards
comment: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

name: Donte DiVincenzo
comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

name: Trey Murphy III
comment: Murphy (knee) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Spurs.

comment: Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.

name: OG Anunoby

name: Jordan Clarkson
comment: Clarkson (foot) won't play in Saturday's game against Portland.

name: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander

name: Nikola Topic
comment: Topic (hip) is listed as out for Sunday's game versus the Heat.

name: Jaylin Williams
comment: Williams (back) is listed as out for Sunday's game against Miami.

name: Alex Caruso
comment: Caruso (hip) won't play Sunday against the Heat.

name: Thomas Sorber
comment: Sorber underwent an arthroscopic knee procedure Tuesday to address inflammation at the patellofemoral joint in his right knee, and he's expected to return to on-court activities in 6-8 weeks, Steve McGehee of News 9 Oklahoma City reports.

name: Cason Wallace
comment: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

name: Chet Holmgren
comment: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

name: Jalen Williams
comment: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

name: Jonathan Isaac
comment: Isaac (knee) is out for Sunday's game against the Wizards.

name: Izaiyah Nelson
comment: Head coach Sean Sweeney said Wednesday that Nelson (ankle) has been doing "some on-court stuff," though Sweeney added that the work has been "minimal," Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

name: Noah Penda
comment: Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

name: Paolo Banchero
comment: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Dean Wade
comment: Wade (hamstring) won't play Saturday against the Bucks.

name: Adem Bona
comment: Bona (back) participated in Friday's practice, though he still needs to go through a full practice with contact before being cleared to return to game action, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

name: Jaylen Brown
comment: Brown (hamstring) went through individual work during Friday's practice, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.

name: Ariel Hukporti
comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Ryan Dunn
comment: Dunn won't return to Friday's game against the Jazz due to a right quad injury, Amanda Pflugrad of 3TV Phoenix reports.

name: Mark Williams
comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Chris Youngblood
comment: Youngblood (heel) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Knicks.

name: Vit Krejci
comment: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

name: Ja Morant
comment: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.

name: Shaedon Sharpe
comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Precious Achiuwa

name: Maxime Raynaud

name: Ben Simmons

name: Dylan Harper

name: Tobias Harris
comment: Harris (calf) is likely to be sidelined until early December, per Jeff Garcia of KENS 5 San Antonio.

name: Jayden Quaintance

name: Collin Murray-Boyles

name: Kawhi Leonard

name: Nate Bittle

name: Jusuf Nurkic

name: Lauri Markkanen

name: Jaren Jackson Jr.

name: Tristan Vukcevic

name: Reece Beekman

name: Justin Champagnie
comment: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

name: Jamir Watkins
comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
